item.title: Retailers Of Ennis Say O’Connell Street Pedestrianisation Best Outcome They Could’ve Hoped For
item.description: A group representing the business community of Ennis says the proposed permanent pedestrianisation of the town’s main street is the best outcome they could’ve hoped for. item.title: In Profile – Bobby McMahon
item.description: This week’s guest for In Profile is Bobby McMahon. Bobby McMahon is a Clare man who found himself living in the Land of the Rising Sun!
